studio-black.$description: Studio Black — Primary text, dark section backgrounds, nav background on scroll — full-spectrum black with no tint creates maximum contrast against white sections

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page background, card surfaces, text on dark sections, button fills

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — Body text on white backgrounds, button text on white buttons — near-black with the faintest cool tint

graphite-stroke.$description: Graphite Stroke — Border color on white buttons, secondary text, dividers

fog-border.$description: Fog Border — Input borders, card dividers, subtle separators

ash-mid.$description: Ash Mid — Placeholder text in inputs, secondary metadata

charcoal-surface.$description: Charcoal Surface — Elevated dark card backgrounds on black sections — one step lighter than pure black to create surface depth without shadows

skill-green.$description: Skill Green — Primary CTA button fill, brand accent — a muted-vivid green that reads warm against black and cool against white, avoiding both danger and safety connotations

neon-pulse.$description: Neon Pulse — Checkmark icons on feature lists, active fill states — saturated to near-glow, appears only as small marks on black backgrounds where luminosity hits hardest

electric-cyan.$description: Electric Cyan — Secondary accent, stat highlights, animated elements on dark sections

creator-violet.$description: Creator Violet — Hover state backgrounds, link accent on specialized flows

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Active/pressed state for violet interactive elements

facebook-blue.$description: Facebook Blue — Facebook social login icon fill — brand color of the platform, not Skillshare's own

google-red.$description: Google Red — Google 'G' logo fill in social login button

warning-amber.$description: Warning Amber — Star ratings, achievement indicators

gt-walsheim-pro.$description: Every UI element — headlines at 700 weight with 0.90 line-height produce a stacked poster effect at 46–48px. Body at 400/16px with 1.50 line-height. Buttons and labels at 500–600. Weight 100 appears only in decorative or watermark contexts. The custom font brings rounded geometric terminals that soften the stark black/white palette.

times.$description: System fallback only — appears in legal/fine-print contexts where custom font fails to load. Not an intentional typographic choice.
